story: HI *{name}*! I'M *APOORV*, A DESIGNER FROM LUCKNOW.
*12+ YEARS*, FOUR COMPANIES, AND A LOT OF COFFEE.
INSTEAD OF A RESUME, I BUILT A GAME. *YOU'RE PLAYING ME.*
WALK THROUGH MY STORY, COLLECT THE COINS AND MEET THE TEAM.

rita.name: RITA
lines: WELCOME, *{name}*! I'M RITA. I RUN THIS LOBBY.
YOU'RE ABOUT TO PLAY THROUGH *12+ YEARS* OF DESIGN. FIND THE GOLD *?* COINS TO LEARN THE STORY.
*ARROWS* TO WALK. HOLD *SHIFT* TO RUN. *UP* TO JUMP, *SHIFT+UP* FOR A LONG JUMP.
STAND ON A *GREEN PIPE* AND PRESS *DOWN* TO SLIDE INSIDE. THERE'S A SECRET ROOM!
again: TEN GOLD *?* COINS, {name}. THE FIRST ONE IS JUST AHEAD!

raju.name: RAJU
lines: DESIGNERS RUN ON COFFEE. THIS ONE GIVES YOU *SPEED* AND A *DOUBLE JUMP*!
again: TOO MUCH COFFEE? NEVER. TAKE ANOTHER!

meera.name: MEERA
lines: WELL DONE, *{name}*! THAT'S THE LOBBY DONE.
I LIKE PEOPLE WHO TURN *COMPLEX IDEAS* INTO CLEAR STORIES. YOU JUST DID.
THROUGH THE DOOR IS THE *TRAINING CAMPUS*. SEE YOU THERE!
again: THE DOOR IS RIGHT THERE, {name}. NO MORE EXCUSES!

prof.name: PROF. DAS
lines: WELCOME TO THE *TRAINING CAMPUS*, {name}! I'M PROF. DAS.
FOUR DEGREES, FOUR CLASSROOMS. FINISH EACH *TASK* TO OPEN THE GATE AND EARN THE *SCROLL*.
RELAX, NO EXAMS. THIS IS WHERE I LEARNED TO *THINK*, NOT JUST DRAW.
again: FOUR GATES, {name}. START WITH THE COLOUR LAB!

profEnd.name: PROF. DAS
lines: FOUR SCROLLS, *{name}*! THAT'S A LOT OF LEARNING.
NEXT: THE *OFFICE FLOORS*, WHERE ALL OF THIS GOT PUT TO WORK.
again: THE DOOR IS OPEN, {name}. OFF YOU GO!
